facts.text: Jon expressed excitement about seeing Gina and mentioned an event where dance performances will take place.

evidence.quote: Cool! Can't wait to see you!
My dance studio and some other schools are bringing their best moves for an awesome night of performances and judging.

facts.text: Gina confirmed her attendance at the event and expressed enthusiasm for the show.

evidence.quote: Thanks, Jon! See you at the event!

facts.text: Jon wished Gina luck with her store and expressed appreciation for her support.

evidence.quote: Gina, good luck with your store!

facts.text: Gina thanked Jon for his support and expressed her intention to continue pursuing her goals.

evidence.quote: Thanks, Jon! Appreciate the kind words. <3
